Guardian live blog: full declaration figures. Live blog primaryDateLine 'Fri 9 Oct 2026 11.13 BST'; first published 02.12 BST. Declaration block timestamped 03.15-03.36 BST.
FULL RESULT, Holborn and St Pancras by-election, 8 October 2026 (declared early 9 October):
Sagal Abdi-Wali (Lab) 12,292 (45.17%, -3.75%)
Zack Polanski (Green) 8,928 (32.81%, +22.37%)
Ewan Cameron (C) 1,922 (7.06%, -0.13%)
Peter Newman (Reform) 1,612 (5.92%, -0.22%)
Patrick Stillman (LD) 924 (3.40%, -2.40%)
Tyler Johnson (Restore) 692 (2.54%)
George Galloway (WPB) 314 (1.15%)
Briony Kapoor (Rejoin) 236 (0.87%)
Lab maj 3,364 (12.36%)
Electorate 70,449; Turnout 27,211 (38.63%, -15.52%)
2024 COMPARISON: Lab maj 11,572 (29.98%) - Turnout 38,602 (54.14%). Starmer (Lab) 18,884 (48.92%); Feinstein (ND) 7,312 (18.94%); Stansell (Green) 4,030 (10.44%); Malik (C) 2,776 (7.19%); Roberts (Reform) 2,371 (6.14%); Clinton (LD) 2,236 (5.79%); Islam (Ind) 636.
Candidate full names given in blog: Conservative - Ewan Cameron; Reform UK - Peter Newman; Liberal Democrats - Patrick Thomas Stillman; Restore Britain - Tyler Kurtis Johnson.
Blog notes the Conservatives came third but Reform UK would have beaten the Tories if its candidate had also had the Restore Britain votes; Restore Britain is a problem for Reform UK.
